name: architecture-refactor
description: Kiro SDD refactor workflow: technical debt audit, target boundary design, parity testing safety net, strangler fig migration, and verification

steps.prompt: Scaffold refactor specification: `npm run spec:new -- --name {{inputs.name}} --domain {{inputs.domain}} --title "{{inputs.title}}" --type refactor`.
Identify code smell, coupling, or boundary violations. Define Strangler Fig migration pattern and business parity invariants in brief.json, then run `npm run spec:build -- --name {{inputs.name}}`.
Wave 1: Establish comprehensive baseline parity tests covering existing behavior before touching production code. Commit with [T1].
Wave 2: Execute refactoring incrementally. Replace legacy paths with clean abstractions/facades without breaking external contract DTOs. Commit with [T2].
Wave 3: Verify parity tests 100% pass. Run `npm run check && npm run test:matrix` and check architecture boundary compliance.
